title: Deferred-Interest Payoff Autopay on Ridgeline Consumer Credit — Cardholder Instruction Card
content:
**Rule.** A cardholder who asks for automatic payments that pay off the account's deferred-interest balance before its promotion ends is enrolled in autopay with the fixed-amount option, and the fixed draft amount is the plan's fixed draft amount; each draft is then the greater of that fixed amount and the minimum payment due, as the Ridgeline Consumer Credit autopay terms provide.

## Condition on the plan amount

The plan's fixed draft amount is not worked out until every special order refund issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name in the last 3 months stands on the account as a return credit.

Put the other way: while any special order refund of those 3 months issued to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit tender in the customer's name does not yet stand on the account as a return credit, the plan's fixed draft amount is not yet worked out.

## Business effect

| Request | Result on the account |
|---|---|
| automatic payments that pay off the deferred-interest balance before the promotion ends | autopay on, fixed-amount option, the plan's fixed draft amount recorded, replacing any autopay choice on file |
| each later payment due date | the draft is the greater of the fixed draft amount and that statement's minimum payment due |

## Capability

`set_autopay_payoff_plan_7f80aff1` is the cardholder's own instruction for automatic payments on their own Ridgeline Consumer Credit card at a fixed draft amount. It finds the card by the account number digits the cardholder holds, turns autopay on with the fixed-amount option and records the fixed draft amount, replacing any autopay choice on file. The cardholder sees the new setting and its amount straight away. When no card carries the digits given, nothing is changed and the receipt says so.

## How it is invoked

This is a customer-owned tool: the representative unlocks `set_autopay_payoff_plan_7f80aff1` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it with the values below.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | the identifying number of the cardholder's own card account as the cardholder holds it: the last four digits of the account number printed on the card, 4 digits (for example 0000), as the cardholder states it |
| `autopay_fixed_amount` | the fixed draft amount in USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the nearest cent; it is recorded exactly as given |

## Return

A receipt with: `status` — enrolled when the instruction was recorded, or `not_found` when no card carries those digits; `card_account_id` — the last four digits given; `autopay_enrolled` — True once autopay is on; `autopay_option` — `fixed_amount`; `autopay_fixed_amount` — the recorded draft amount in USD with 2 decimals.
